blocks.text:
1. Fetch the unique combinations of the following columns by mapping the RESOURCE and STAGE in V_PRM_RESOURCE_CONSTRAINT_ROOT with the RESOURCE and STAGE in V_BRD_RESOURCE_CAPACITY_LOCATION_METRIC_ROOT to generate the stage data: Resource, Stage, Location_ID, Parameter_NM, Quantity, and UOM.

2A. Bring the FAB items to the Stage view if they exist in the V_BRD_WAFER_START_CAPACITY_GROUP_PROCESS_CORRIDOR_ITEM_LOCATION_METRIC_CURRENT_ROOT view. This can be done by mapping the 'RESOURCE' column (which contains both item and location information, so trim the item_id and location_id) from the V_PRM_RESOURCE_CONSTRAINT_ROOT_UI where the STAGE ='FAB' with the ITEM_ID and MANUFACTURING_LOCATION_CD in the V_BRD_WAFER_START_CAPACITY_GROUP_PROCESS_CORRIDOR_ITEM_LOCATION_METRIC_CURRENT_ROOT view. If the FAB item exists, include it in the Stage view and populate the corresponding location in the LOCATION_ID column.

extras.text: Assumptions Assuming we receive a full data load from the planners each week, we need to remove the master data combinations if no subsequent data is loaded by planners for future weeks.

Note 1. UI Data Check: Ensure that the data uploaded by the planners in the UOM (Unit of Measure) column is updated as follows:
                             - replace 'Wafers' or 'Wafer' with 'WAF', 'Hours' with 'HRS', and 'Hours per Wafer/Wafers' with 'HRS WAF'. Please provide the list of possible values that may appear in this column. Adi confirmed that these are the only possible values for now.
2. For the 'STAGE' column, ensure that all data is entered in uppercase only (e.g., 'Bump' should be 'BUMP'). Please provide the list of possible values that may appear in this column.
3. As part of the data quality (DQ) check, ensure that all 'SITE' column data entered by the planners matches the location master file.
4. Special Character Validation: If the planner includes any special characters in the uploaded file, an error should be displayed in the UI, and the file should not be saved in the backend. This is in accordance with the BY-level restrictions on special characters.
5. Apply all DQ checks before saving the data to the backend.
6. If the numeric values exceed a length of 10, they should be rounded.
7. If the planner enters a negative value, a valid error should be displayed in the UI.
8. If the planner enters a decimal value, a valid alert should appear in the UI indicating that "Decimal Values are not allowed".
Note Ensure to include the change agents ID, specifically the actual employees data, and that we retain this data until the CORE PIT.

Note 1. UI Data Check: Ensure that the data uploaded by the planners in the UOM (Unit of Measure) column is updated as follows:
                             - replace 'Wafers' or 'Wafer' with 'WAF', 'Hours' with 'HRS', and 'Hours per Wafer/Wafers' with 'HRS WAF'. Please provide the list of possible values that may appear in this column. Adi/Charan needs to confirm with the business on this.
2. For the 'STAGE' column, ensure that all data is entered in uppercase only (e.g., 'Bump' should be 'BUMP'). Please provide the list of possible values that may appear in this column.
3. Special Character Validation: If the planner includes any special characters in the uploaded file, an error should be displayed in the UI, and the file should not be saved in the backend. This is in accordance with the BY-level restrictions on special characters.
4. Apply all DQ checks before saving the data to the backend.
5. Planners should be able to enter a decimal value.
6. Here the UOM should be in WEEK only.

Note If the user starts with WW 50, all work weeks prior to week 50 (i.e., up to WW 49) will be set to zero. For any missing work weeks between the listed weeks, enter the values from the previous week and extend those values forward, filling them across the origin until the last known value.
